quotes.text: This "remnant of Israel" should not be confused with the "remnant of Judah" *Isa. 37:31-32, Jer. 40:11, 15), which would be the Jews. Sometimes a "remnant" (without a modifying phrase) could refer to the descendants of the northern tribes preserved or returning from the Assyrian captivity (2 Chr. 30:6; Isa. 11:11, 16); or it could refer to those returning in the last days from Judah (Micah 5:3; Ezek. 6:8); or it could refer to both groups (Jer. 23:3; Isa. 1:9).
quotes.speaker: Victor L. Ludlow
quotes.attr: Victor L. Ludlow, Unlocking the Old Testament, p.218-219
